description: YHWaterstop series are constructed from flexible thermoplastic PVC. They are designed to stop the migration of water through construction joints in concrete structures.
whereToUse: YHWaterstop V series is suitable for the effective sealing of concrete construction joints in structures, such as water reservoirs, sewage treatment plants, swimming pools, basements, retaining walls, lift shafts, tunnels, culverts, etc.
YHWaterstop O series is suitable for the effective sealing of concrete expansion joints in structures
YHWaterstop A series is suitable for the effective sealing of concrete construction joints in structures
YHWaterstop D series is suitable for the effective sealing of concrete expansion joints in structures
It is used for construction joints and movement joints where nominal movement is anticipated, such as basement or retaining walls
advantages: Good sealing: After concrete has hardened the sealing function starts
Easy to be welded on site
Designed rib profiles provide barriers to water migration
notFor: YHWaterstop V performs its function only if both sides are well embedded in the concrete

Placing of fresh concrete near the YHWaterstop V requires care, as otherwise it will be forced from its position by the pressure of the fresh concrete, i.e. the ends will fold up. To prevent this, the same concrete pressure must be present on both sides of the Waterstop
Removal of formwork in the neighborhood of YHWaterstop V must be done with care
Failures can be caused by irregularities of cut edges, insufficient heat, dust etc.

storage: The product should be stored in ventilated places, with no exposure to sunlight, rain, or fire. The storage temperature should be between 5 °C and 30 °C. The shelf life is at least 12 months under normal transportation and storage conditions.
